formal_statement:
∀ (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (s : Fin n → Bool),
  (∀ u v : Fin n, G.Adj u v → s u ≠ s v) →
  (∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 n C ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun n C = PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.graphFun G ∅) →
  ∃ D : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.TopForm.IsLeastAO G D ∧
    ∀ i < D.gates.length, ∀ j < D.gates.length,
      (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt D i).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and →
      (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.gateAt D j).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and →
      ¬ PEqualNP.EdgeOwnership.InCone n D i j
plain_statement: For every bipartite graph G whose edge function F has an AND/OR circuit with each gate reading exactly two earlier wires (so it reads only earlier wires), some least such circuit for F has AND-depth one: no AND gate lies in the cone of another AND gate.
title: AND-depth one: every bipartite edge function has a least fan-in-two AND/OR circuit in which no AND gate lies in the cone of another AND gate
